translations.web: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
translations.bsb: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
translations.kjv: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
translations.asv: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.
